name: Mongol Empire & Yuan Dynasty
summary: Uniting the nomadic tribes of the Mongolian steppe in 1206, Genghis Khan and his descendants forged the largest contiguous land empire in human history from Korea and China to Persia, Russia, and Hungary—creating the "Pax Mongolica" postal relay (Yam) traveled by Marco Polo and Ibn Battuta.
